rationale.A: ~1.2 km in traffic on Hauenkalliontie/Haukilahdenkatu plus Malminrinne tram; many unsignalled crossings, 9 lights
rationale.B: Coastal path through Westend and Lauttasaari, Baana; only 180 m on Eteläinen Rautatiekatu; same time as A
rationale.C: Like B but Lauttasaari via Wavulinintie in traffic; 7 lights
rationale.D: Same coastal path as B but finishing via Baana with no mixed traffic; 4 lights, +3 min
rationale.E: Like B with a Tapiola detour; +10 min
rationale.F: Long side paths beside Kuusisaarentie/Paciuksenkatu (50 km/h) via Munkkiniemi; +11 min

notes: B (+0) already removes A's collector traffic. D is the same route with a calmer finish and 5 fewer lights than A, so one D card covers both.
